candidate_change_stop.reason: The retained application assumes the native Request URL has the public authority. Next 15.5.25 persistent hosting constructs internal authorities in runMiddleware and attachRequestMeta; render-server supplies localhost even when startup hostname is omitted. The application relies on that native URL for both redirects and strict Connect/Nova origin checks.
smallest_proposed_change: Introduce one reviewed public-origin resolution contract at the application HTTP boundary using configured exact issuer/resource/application origins and the trusted exact-host ingress. Reject unknown/malformed authorities and forged forwarded authorities; do not accept arbitrary X-Forwarded-Host or replace every request with the configured audience.

Use that contract for Connect/Nova request-origin validation and same-site middleware/auth redirects. Keep URL paths, callback registration, tokens, scopes, PKCE, entitlement checks and current-grant revocation unchanged.

Build a separately identified candidate from the reviewed source snapshot. Preserve this candidate and failed evidence; do not patch compiled output, Next internals, or Location headers as a substitute.
